title: A/P Detail: a PDF over 2,000 rows is refused, the CSV downloads
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has more than 2,000 and fewer than 50,000 open A/P lines on today's date.
    For example: the QA organization, with 13,540 open A/P lines.
  • Starting screen: A/P Detail (Reports, then "A/P Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Choose "Download (PDF)" from the ⋯ menu.
  2. Count the messages that show and look at the browser's downloads.
  3. Choose "Download (CSV)" from the ⋯ menu.
  4. Open the CSV and count its document rows (leave out the heading and the Totals row).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the error message "This report is too large for PDF. Export it as CSV, or narrow the filters, then try again." shows straight away.
  • Step 2: exactly one message, no second generic error, and no PDF was downloaded.
  • Step 3: the CSV downloads with the "Success" message.
  • Step 4: the count matches the report's document rows (for example 13,540).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV)

  • S3-N1: “Over 2,000 rows, the PDF is refused before anything is generated: no download, and the message "This report is too large for PDF. Export it as CSV, or narrow the filters, then try again." Exactly 2,000 rows is allowed.”
  • S3-N3: “A refused export shows exactly one message (S3-N1 or S3-N2), never a second generic error.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “PDF export over 2,000 rows | "This report is too large for PDF. Export it as CSV, or narrow the filters, then try again." | Error toast, as on the other reports; nothing downloads”
  • S3-R9: “The row count for the export limits is the number of customer or vendor rows (Summaries) or document rows (the other four), not counting headers, subtotals or the Totals row.”
  • Assumptions: “A shop's A/P Detail can carry well over 10,000 open lines (the QA organization has 13,540 on one as-of date and 437 vendors); A/R Summary in the same organization has 46 customers.”
